Company Background
[1]
3P Land Holdings Limited (formerly Pudumjee Industries Limited) changed its name in Apr'18 and is part of the M.P. Jatia Group. Incorporated in 1965 as a paper manufacturing company, it expanded into tissue and hygiene products, including a joint venture with Kimberly-Clark. Subsequently, the hygiene business was demerged into Pudumjee Paper Products Limited in 2016. The Company has since transitioned from manufacturing to focusing on real estate development.
